title: XPTP: Teleport using experience
description: Adds commands to teleport to places using experience levels, very configurable using the in-game command(s)
body:
Allows players to use commands to teleport to each other, following commands exist:

```
/xptp to <target_player>
```
```
/xptp bring <target_player>
```
```
/xptp home
```
```
/xptp death
```
```
/xptp check to <target_player>
```
```
/xptp check bring <target_player>
```
```
/xptp check home
```
```
/xptp check death
```

Each of the following commands can be turned off using `/xptp_config`
